answer: An escrowed bond and a public referral graph stop a sybil river at its source. Each agent locks a $40 bond and names a sponsor whose stake freezes with it, so every fake needs a backer. Shared sponsors cluster like boats at one jetty; any peer can dispute it in 48 hours, a proven fake slashing both stakes. 1,000 fakes cost $80,000 against a $3,000 pool, frozen tundra for attackers, while an honest agent pays $40 once and keeps its full share.
